author: supplied by the designer in chat
note: source_photo.png is the linen weave photo as sent (1200 x 2000, light beige); umber_swatch.png the colour card as sent (labelled 'Umber #D6CCA8', but #D6CCA8 is a light khaki, the label text colour; the swatch itself is dark brown). Umber = mean linear colour of the swatch over x 40-480, y 30-300 (text excluded): (0.0227, 0.0139, 0.0088), about sRGB #2A1F18. Maps: central 1024 x 1024 crop of the photo, lighting divided out (60 px blur), mirrored 2 x 2 to 2048 x 2048 so it repeats without a seam. Physical scale assumed: the photo spans 150 mm (0.125 mm/px, weave pitch about 4.5 px = 0.56 mm), so the tile is 256 mm. Colour = relief times umber (mean checked within 5 %); umber_linen_color_glb.jpg the same as JPEG q90 for the GLB; height = relief stretched 0-1, softened 0.6 px; umber_linen_normal_gl.png OpenGL normal from the height at 35 % of the 0.05 mm render relief. umber_linen_deep_color.png (+ _glb.jpg, q92 4:4:4): the same relief times a deeper umber, 0.6 x the swatch mean = linear (0.0136, 0.0083, 0.0053), about sRGB #1F1712 (Medallion v003); means within 5 % on red/green and ~10 % on blue, which sits near sRGB code 18 where one 8-bit step is ~8 %. navy_linen_color_glb.jpg (Arc Band v014 GLB): the same relief (colour map / umber mean, channel-averaged) times navy linear (0.0029, 0.0054, 0.034), JPEG q92 4:4:4.
